    Simple socles of stable representables #

    Pointwise coefficient duality embeds the dual of a stable representable into the dual corepresentable at the same indecomposable. This is the injective envelope used in Auslander--Reiten's socle-series proof of Corollary 3.8.

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.isEssentialMono_of_simple_comp_mono_into_injective_local_end {C₀ : Type u₀} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₀, u₀} C₀] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C₀] {T H I : C₀} [CategoryTheory.Simple T] [CategoryTheory.Injective I] [IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End I)] (t : T ⟶ H) (m : H ⟶ I) [CategoryTheory.Mono m] (s : T ⟶ I) [CategoryTheory.Mono s] (hs : s ≠ 0) (htm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp t m = s) :
    IsEssentialMono t
